{{Quote|I am C-3PO, human-cyborg relations.|C-3PO|<ref name="Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (novelization)">[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' novelization]]</ref>}}
The '''3PO-series protocol droid''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]]-[[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] relations [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] produced by [[Cybot Galactica/Legends|Cybot Galactica]]. The model series had very similar aesthetic design in its casing to other Cybot Galactica droid model series such as the [[TC-series protocol droid/Legends|TC-series]], [[3PX-series protocol droid|3PX-series]], and [[5YQ-series protocol droid]]s.

One of the most famous [[Droid/Legends|droids]] of this series was [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], one of the heroes of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].

==Description==
3PO-series [[Droid/Legends|droids]] had a bipedal [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] design, standing 1.7 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in height.<ref name="EGTD" /> It incorporated a [[C-Family Protocol Head]], [[C-Family Protocol torso]], a [[Versatile Humanoid Biped Unit]], arms and hands. Typical 3PO units weighed around 77.6 [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]] and had a maximum walking speed of twenty-one [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] an [[Standard hour/Legends|hour]].<ref name="Star Wars: DroidWorks">''[[Star Wars: DroidWorks]]''</ref>

Each droid was equipped with a [[SyntheTech/Legends|SyntheTech]] [[AA-1 VerboBrain/Legends|AA-1 VerboBrain]]. The [[Droid brain/Legends|brain's]] advanced neural network and superior cognition allowed 3PO units to parse content and process numbers with ease. The VerboBrain gave 3PO units the ability to develop genuine emotions and allowed original personalities to emerge. However, these personalities were often nervous, flighty, and borderline neurotic,<ref name="EGTD" /> and tended to be subservient and service oriented.<ref name="CFTD" /> [[Cybot Galactica/Legends|Cybot Galactica]] were forced to add [[creativity damper]]s to the droid to ensure that their translations were unembellished. The company also recommended regular [[Memory wipe/Legends|memory wipes]] to prevent 3PO units from developing personality quirks.<ref name="EGTD" />

[[File:C-3POnakedNEGTC.jpg|thumb|right|250px|C-3PO without metal coverings.]]
A [[TranLang III communications module/Legends|TranLang III communications module]] allowed 3PO units to be fluent in over six million forms of communication. The droid's [[Vocabulator/Legends|vocabulator]] could replicate any sound it heard with the correct intonation and timbre, allowing it to communicate directly. However, the droid's humanoid-shaped chassis did limit its ability to duplicate [[Alien/Legends|alien]] sign language, such as the subtle movements used by the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] when communicating with their [[Lekku/Legends|lekku]]. They also had the skills necessary to quickly analyze new unregistered [[Language/Legends|languages]] and translate them.<ref name="EGTD" />

3PO units were equipped with [[Photoreceptor/Legends|photoreceptors]], [[Audio sensor/Legends|auditory pickups]], [[Broadband antenna/Legends|broadband antenna receivers]], [[Microwave sensor|microwave detector]], and [[Olfactory sensor/Legends|olfactory sensors]]. The primary [[circuit breaker]] was conveniently located at the back of their neck, on a very easy to reach place.<ref name="EGTD" />

Droids in the 3PO-series came in a variety of colors, the most usual being gold, silver and white. They required frequent [[Oil bath/Legends|oil baths]] to ensure that their joints and couplings remained in good working condition.
<ref name="EGTD" /> 3PO units retailed for 3,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] on the open market.<ref name="CFTD" />

==Role==
3PO units were experts in communication, etiquette, customs, religious rituals, and other similar fields. They were widely employed by [[Senator/Legends|senators]], [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassadors]], [[Politics/Legends|politicians]], [[Consul/Legends|consuls]], and royalty, acting as [[Translator/Legends|translator]]s, diplomatic attachés and [[Aide/Legends|aides]].<ref name="EGTD" />

3PO units were among the most [[Human/Legends|humanlike]] droids ever produced. [[Sentientologist]] and linguistic researchers found that the 3PO's ability to analyze patterns to decipher unknown languages made the droid an invaluable tool to their research.<ref name="EGTD" />

==History==
Cybot Galactica began producing 3PO-style droids well over a [[Standard century/Legends|century]] prior to the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]<ref name="NEGTD">''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> on droid [[Factory/Legends|factory]] [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] such as [[Affa/Legends|Affa]].<ref name="Databank">{{DB|droid|c3po|C-3PO (See-Threepio)}}</ref> The success of the line led Cybot Galactica to release several "boutique" models, keeping the line fresh. Usually priced up at twice the cost of a standard 3PO, each new line extension showcased a technological innovation, such as memory units with larger capacities, or a more advanced vocabulator. Lines produced over the years included the [[TC-series protocol droid/Legends|TC]], [[3PX-series protocol droid|PX]], [[Consul360]], and [[ii77]] models.<ref name="NEGTD" /> Models such as the pricey [[E-3PO]] included the [[TechSpan I]] module, making it possible to interface with [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] networks and undocumented technologies of Imperial subcontractors.<ref name="E3PO">{{DB|droid|e3po|E-3PO}}</ref> Eventually, the technology highlighted by the new models became standard and incorporated into the mainstream 3PO model, and the line extension was retired.<ref name="NEGTD">''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>

The success of the 3PO-series led Cybot Galactica to produce the [[C-series protocol droid]]s during the rule of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. They officially denied speculation that the series was commissioned to capitalize on the fact that [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] was one of the most well-known droids serving the New Republic.<ref name="EGTD" /> 3PO droids would still be in use by [[137 ABY]], over a century after the fall of the New Republic; with one serving as staff at the [[Naboo Queen (restaurant)|Naboo Queen]] restaurant by this time.<ref name="Legacy 15">[[Legacy (2006) 15|''Legacy'' (2006) 15]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The basic shape of C-3PO, and thus the 3PO-series, was inspired by Maria, a robot in the 1927 German silent film ''Metropolis'', and sculptress [[Liz Moore]] further developed the droid's design.<ref name="Chronicles">''[[Star Wars Chronicles]]''</ref>
